summary.text: Steve Pape is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 35B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Kari Rehrauer (D).
He was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Steve Pape ran for Minnesota House District 35B in 2024 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Kari Rehrauer, who received 50.5 percent of the vote.
